items.summary: A committee of the Mecca defence pact between Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan will hold talks in Riyadh on Monday, with Turkish ministers among those attending, the Turkish foreign ministry said on Sunday.
items.body:
A committee of the Mecca defence pact between Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan will hold talks in Riyadh on Monday, with Turkish ministers among those attending, the Turkish foreign ministry said on Sunday.
[USN:L1N45Q02D TEXT:"The leader of Yemen's Saudi-backed government"] announced on Sunday the beginning of a major military operation against the Iran-backed Houthis earlier on Sunday, aimed at seizing the territory under their control.
[USN:L1N45O0G0 TEXT:"Pakistan's foreign minister said on Friday"] that Iran had suggested engaging Yemen's Houthis politically after attacks by the group, an idea that the Mecca defence pact committee would discuss at a meeting in Riyadh this week.
"The meeting will address recent developments in the region and the stage reached in the Alliance’s institutionalisation efforts," the Turkish statement said.
It said Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan, Defence Minister Yasar Guler and chief of the general staff General Selcuk Bayraktaroglu would attend the meeting of the pact's strategic political and defence committee, along with officials from Pakistan and Saudi Arabia.

items.title: Rusia dice haber atacado un puente de Kiev y dos buques en el mar Negro
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Rusia atacó el domingo el puente del Norte sobre el río Dniéper, en Kiev, con el objetivo de cortar una ruta utilizada para el transporte de soldados y material militar, informó el Ministerio de Defensa ruso.
items.body:
Rusia atacó el domingo el puente del Norte sobre el río Dniéper, en Kiev, con el objetivo de cortar una ruta utilizada para el transporte de soldados y material militar, informó el Ministerio de Defensa ruso.
El ministerio también dijo que había atacado dos buques de carga seca que transportaban equipamiento militar hacia el puerto de Odesa, en el noroeste del mar Negro.
En un comunicado anterior, el ministerio había indicado que las fuerzas rusas habían atacado durante la noche un buque de carga seca al este de Odesa, así como un centro logístico de Nova Poshta en Chornomorsk y un centro de datos en Odesa.
El domingo, Rusia prometió intensificar los ataques contra Ucrania después de que el presidente ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski, declarara a Reuters que Kiev intensificaría los ataques contra las refinerías de petróleo rusas.
El ministerio dijo que las fuerzas de defensa aérea habían interceptado y destruido 559 drones ucranianos entre las 20:00 hora de Moscú (1700 GMT) del sábado y las 08:00 hora de Moscú (0500 GMT) del domingo sobre varias regiones rusas y sobre los mares de Azov y Negro.
Reuters no pudo verificar de forma independiente las afirmaciones.

items.title: Merz anuncia nova ajuda militar em Kiev e diz que Alemanha não vai se intimidar
items.author: Andreas Rinke, Felix Hoske
items.creator: Andreas Rinke, Felix Hoske
items.summary: A Alemanha não vai se deixar intimidar a ponto de retirar seu apoio à Ucrânia, afirmou o chanceler Friedrich Merz neste domingo, ao anunciar mais 1 bilhão de euros (1,1 bilhão de dólares) em ajuda militar durante uma visita a Kiev marcada por ataques de drones russos.
items.body:
A Alemanha não vai se deixar intimidar a ponto de retirar seu apoio à Ucrânia, afirmou o chanceler Friedrich Merz neste domingo, ao anunciar mais 1 bilhão de euros (1,1 bilhão de dólares) em ajuda militar durante uma visita a Kiev marcada por ataques de drones russos.
Sirenes de ataque aéreo e explosões ecoaram repetidamente pela capital ucraniana enquanto Merz e o presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskiy visitavam um memorial aos soldados mortos durante a guerra que já dura quatro anos, bem como a Academia de Ciências, onde pelo menos duas pessoas morreram em um ataque com drones na semana passada.
A Rússia intensificou seus ataques com drones a Kiev e outras cidades nas últimas semanas, tendo como alvo infraestruturas de telecomunicações, eletricidade e transporte, bem como instalações militares.
Em coletiva de imprensa ao lado de Zelenskiy, Merz afirmou que Moscou estava tentando abalar o ânimo do povo ucraniano e anunciou 350 milhões de euros para reparos no setor de energia. Ele disse que a Alemanha continua sendo o maior apoiador da Ucrânia.
ACORDOS COM EMPRESAS ALEMÃS NO VALOR DE 6,5 BILHÕES DE EUROS "Fazemos isso não apenas para proteger a integridade territorial da Ucrânia; fazemos isso profundamente em nosso próprio interesse, pois é uma questão de segurança da Europa", disse Merz, observando que a Rússia estava realizando ataques cibernéticos e campanhas de desinformação que atingiam a ordem democrática da Europa.
"Isso demonstra que não nos deixaremos intimidar", disse ele.
A Rússia afirmou que as acusações de guerra híbrida são infundadas e resultado de histeria antirussa.
Autoridades informaram que executivos de empresas alemãs, que viajaram com Merz, assinaram 16 acordos com o governo e empresas ucranianas no valor aproximado de 6,5 bilhões de euros.
Entre esses acordos, a Ucrânia assinou um contrato com a alemã Diehl Defence para o fornecimento de mísseis de defesa aérea IRIS-T, bem como um acordo para equipamentos de radar com a Hensoldt e para drones interceptadores a jato com a Quantum Systems.
Zelenskiy elogiou um novo drone interceptador a jato, chamado SPYS e desenvolvido pela Quantum, por apresentar resultados promissores. Ele afirmou que a Ucrânia e a Alemanha estão prestes a finalizar um amplo acordo de defesa, que, segundo ele havia dito anteriormente, incluiria a produção de drones, mísseis e software relacionado.
ZELENSKIY PROMETE RESPONDER Desde o verão, a Rússia tem atacado diariamente infraestruturas civis e militares com dezenas de drones de ataque a jato de alta velocidade -- que a Ucrânia tem tido dificuldade em derrubar, pois são muito mais rápidos do que as versões anteriores com hélice.
Um dos ataques russos no domingo atingiu a Ponte do Norte, que atravessa o rio Dnipro, danificando sua pista, disse o prefeito de Kiev, Vitali Klitschko, no Telegram. A explosão feriu duas pessoas e danificou um sistema de abastecimento de água quente na área, afirmou ele.
Zelenskiy afirmou que a decisão da Rússia de intensificar os ataques aéreos contra alvos de infraestrutura se deveu aos reveses sofridos no campo de batalha e prometeu que a Ucrânia retaliaria. Ele disse que o presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, queria forçar os moradores a fugir das principais cidades da Ucrânia.
"Se nossas pontes desabarem, conseguiremos sair dessa situação, mas o povo dele também sentirá o impacto... Essa é a escalada máxima desta guerra", disse Zelenskiy aos repórteres.
A Rússia vem atacando as pontes de Kiev desde a semana passada, em uma tentativa de interromper as conexões entre os dois lados da capital e as rotas logísticas entre o centro e o leste da Ucrânia.
MERZ APELA PELO FIM DA "GUERRA SEM SENTIDO" Zelenskiy disse que o enviado de paz dos EUA, Steve Witkoff, lhe enviou uma mensagem para instar ao retorno às negociações trilaterais o mais rápido possível. Ele afirmou que a Ucrânia está disposta a se reunir ainda este mês e espera que a Rússia participe, mas ressaltou que os aliados ocidentais precisam exercer mais pressão sobre Moscou para pôr fim à guerra.
No início do dia, durante a visita à Academia de Ciências, que sofreu graves danos, Merz apelou a Putin para que "ponha fim a esta guerra sem sentido".
"Estamos prontos para as negociações, estamos prontos para discutir o fim desta guerra, mas esses ataques bárbaros contra a população civil da Ucrânia precisam parar", disse o líder alemão.
O Ministério das Relações Exteriores da Rússia informou no sábado que Moscou continuaria a atingir sistematicamente alvos na Ucrânia, no que classificou como ataques de retaliação aos ataques ucranianos contra a Rússia. O ministério alertou cidadãos estrangeiros e funcionários diplomáticos contra viagens à Ucrânia.

items.title: Nicarágua anuncia saída do Parlamento Centro-Americano
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Nicarágua está se retirando do Parlamento Centro-Americano, agravando seu isolamento no cenário internacional, conforme o país é acusado de violações generalizadas dos direitos humanos.
items.body:
A Nicarágua está se retirando do Parlamento Centro-Americano, agravando seu isolamento no cenário internacional, conforme o país é acusado de violações generalizadas dos direitos humanos.
Em comunicado divulgado no sábado, o Ministério das Relações Exteriores informou que havia decidido denunciar o tratado de 1987 que instituiu o Parlamento composto por seis países “no pleno exercício de sua soberania”. Disse que a medida entraria em vigor imediatamente.
O governo da Nicarágua não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentários adicionais.
A ação ocorreu após uma resolução aprovada na sexta-feira pela Organização dos Estados Americanos (OEA), que instou as autoridades nicaraguenses a libertar presos políticos e restaurar as liberdades civis. A Nicarágua deixou a OEA em 2023, alegando que a organização diplomática havia se tornado uma ferramenta para o intervencionismo dos EUA.
Em 2025, a Nicarágua também anunciou que se retiraria do Conselho de Direitos Humanos das Nações Unidas, após um relatório da ONU que pedia à comunidade internacional a abordar as violações dos direitos humanos cometidas pela Nicarágua.
A Nicarágua está mergulhada em uma crise política desde abril de 2018, quando protestos sociais reprimidos pela polícia resultaram em mais de 350 mortos, 2.000 feridos e milhares de detenções e pessoas fugindo do país.
Em julho passado, o governo liderado por Daniel Ortega e sua esposa, Rosario Murillo, anunciou que o país não realizaria mais eleições. Ortega está no poder ininterruptamente desde 2007, após um mandato presidencial anterior na década de 1980.

items.title: イラン、米の回答に立場表明　再攻撃なら対応と外相
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ドバイ ４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ドバイ ４日 ロイター] - イラン外務省のバガイ報道官は４日、ホルムズ海峡再開に関する直近の提案への米国の回答に対するイランの大まかな立場を仲介国を通じて米国側に伝えたと述べた。また、イランが米国の制裁緩和と引き換えに、国際原子力機関（ＩＡＥＡ）による核施設の査察受け入れを提案したとの情報を否定し、米国とは核協議に入っていないと説明した。

イランは９月の国連総会期間中に、条件が満たされればホルムズ海峡を再開し、７日以内に通常の船舶航行を回復させるとする提案を示した。米国は９月下旬に仲介役のカタールを通じてこの提案に回答した。

バガイ氏は、「米国側の提案は、特に核問題について、従来の立場とほぼ変わらない。われわれは、現段階で重視するのはホルムズ海峡の問題であり、同海峡の安全を取り戻すには米国が明確な措置を講じる必要があると伝えた」と述べた。米政府に伝える追加の論点がまだ残っていると説明した。

イラン側の交渉責任者を務めるガリバフ国会議長は４日、６月の暫定合意で定めたイラン側の７つの条件が満たされるまで、ホルムズ海峡は再開しないと述べた。国営メディアが伝えた。

アラグチ外相は４日、イラン駐在の各国大使や外交官に対し、米国が外交を選ぶことを望むと述べた。ただ、米国が再び軍事行動を選んだ場合は対応する用意があると警告し、「彼らが再び軍事的解決に向かうなら、われわれは以前より準備が整っており、自衛のために必要なあらゆる行動を取る」と述べた。

ロイターは１日、関係筋の話として、米国が大規模な軍事攻撃を再開した場合に備え、イランがより広範で強力な対応を準備していると報じた。

イラン軍の報道官は４日、ファルス通信に対し、ミサイルの射程を延ばす方針だと語った。

items.title: Trump nombra al jefe de inteligencia Clayton como zar de la IA, liderará grupo de trabajo
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el domingo que había nombrado al director de Inteligencia Nacional, Jay Clayton, como zar de la inteligencia artificial de la administración, encargándole la coordinación de los esfuerzos del Gobierno federal para mantener el liderazgo del país en esta tecnología.
items.body:
El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el domingo que había nombrado al director de Inteligencia Nacional, Jay Clayton, como zar de la inteligencia artificial de la administración, encargándole la coordinación de los esfuerzos del Gobierno federal para mantener el liderazgo del país en esta tecnología.
Trump, que ha impulsado el cambio de nombre de la inteligencia artificial por el de "superinteligencia", dijo que Clayton dirigiría la recién creada Fuerza de Superinteligencia (SIF), supervisando la colaboración del Gobierno con los consumidores, los grupos religiosos, las empresas de IA y otras partes interesadas.
En una publicación en su plataforma Truth Social, Trump escribió que la SIF tendría como objetivo "garantizar que Estados Unidos siga liderando el mundo en superinteligencia" y "proteger los intereses y mejorar las vidas de todos los estadounidenses".
El anuncio confirmó una noticia del Wall Street Journal en la que Clayton, nombrado jefe de inteligencia en agosto, afirmaba que Trump le había elegido para liderar los esfuerzos de la administración por mantener a Estados Unidos a la vanguardia de la IA. "El riesgo de no ser los primeros es elevado", dijo Clayton al periódico.
Clayton señaló que el grupo de trabajo dispondría de 120 días para elaborar un informe en el que se evalúen los riesgos y las oportunidades que plantea la inteligencia artificial y se recomiende qué papel debería desempeñar el Gobierno federal.
La seguridad de la IA se ha convertido en un asunto de gran relevancia en las últimas semanas, y algunos investigadores han advertido de que quienes desarrollan esta tecnología creen que podría matar a humanos en menos de una década. Varios parlamentarios demócratas y republicanos han reaccionado con preocupación y han pedido que se tomen más medidas.
Trump parece haber adoptado un enfoque moderado respecto a la regulación de la IA, argumentando que una supervisión excesiva podría debilitar la competitividad frente a China. El martes dijo que no desea colaborar con el presidente chino, Xi Jinping, en la regulación de la tecnología.
El grupo de trabajo de Clayton analizará los riesgos relacionados con la IA y los actuales mecanismos gubernamentales de notificación de infracciones, ataques informáticos y otros incidentes, y recomendará formas de reforzar las capacidades de respuesta federal en el marco de las competencias existentes, informó el Journal, citando los estatutos del grupo de trabajo.
Esta es la segunda vez que Trump nombra a un asesor para supervisar las decisiones relacionadas con la IA en toda la Administración. El inversor de capital de riesgo David Sacks ocupó el cargo de zar de la IA al inicio del segundo mandato del presidente.
Además de Clayton, entre los líderes del grupo de trabajo se encontrarán el presidente de la Comisión Federal de Comercio, Andrew Ferguson; el director de Tecnología del Pentágono, Emil Michael; y el director de la Oficina de Gestión de Personal, Scott Kupor, según escribió Trump.
El grupo informará al presidente y a la jefa de gabinete de la Casa Blanca, Susie Wiles, dijo.

items.title: Messi farewell closes a long, hard-won love story with Argentina
items.author: Angelica Medina
items.creator: Angelica Medina
items.summary: When Lionel Messi makes his final appearance for Argentina on Tuesday, it will bring to an end a journey that began with the country's football authorities not even knowing his name.
items.body:
When Lionel Messi makes his final appearance for Argentina on Tuesday, it will bring to an end a journey that began with the country's football authorities not even knowing his name and evolved into one of the most enduring relationships in sporting history.
The farewell against Benin at Buenos Aires' Monumental stadium ends an international career spanning more than two decades, which began with Argentina scrambling to identify a teenage prodigy developing far from home.
"He went through so many moments that they're really very different eras. At first he suffered enormously with the national team. He truly endured it," Argentine journalist and author Sergio Levinsky, who wrote "Messi and Everything Else", told Reuters.
Messi moved to Barcelona as a teenager and, while Spain tried to persuade him to represent them, his own country barely knew he existed.
At the 2003 Under-17 World Cup in Finland, Spain beat Argentina 3-2 after extra time in the semi-finals.
According to Levinsky, a young Cesc Fabregas, who scored twice and was Messi's teammate at Barcelona's La Masia academy, told Argentine delegates afterwards: "You lost to us because we've got your best player at Barcelona and he's a genius."
Argentina youth coach Hugo Tocalli recalled a similar encounter. He said at the Ole Summit last month that Spain's head chef told him Argentina needed "a kid who plays in Barcelona" to win the tournament.
Finding the boy from Rosario proved difficult.
Argentine Football Association (AFA) employee Omar Souto tracked down the Messi family in Spain through a Rosario telephone directory, only to ask for "Leonardo".
"His name isn't Leonardo, it's Lionel," Souto was told, according to the documentary "Messi: The Forgotten Tape".
The confusion even extended to the paperwork.
The AFA sent Barcelona a fax asking about a player called "Mecci," spelling the surname with a double "c" because officials believed he might be Italian, Levinsky said.
A LOVE UNDER CONSTRUCTION After those complications, Messi played two under-20 friendlies for Argentina in 2004, his first appearances in the blue and white stripes.
Yet scepticism lingered.
At the 2005 Under-20 World Cup in the Netherlands, Messi began on the bench as Argentina lost their opening game.
"There was strong resistance to calling up a kid who didn't play in the country," Levinsky said. "He had to fight against those early suspicions, against being considered a foreigner because he lived in Spain."
He was later criticised for failing to reproduce his club form and labelled "pecho frio", lacking heart or fire, by some fans.
A World Cup qualifier against Colombia in 2011 began to change that perception, as Messi helped Argentina rally from a goal down to win in difficult conditions.
"He was exhausted, even vomiting, and he ended up winning," Levinsky said. "It was the first time fans saw him differently."
The bond strengthened when Messi briefly retired after Argentina's penalty shootout defeat by Chile in the 2016 Copa America final. Rather than blame him, Argentines pleaded publicly for him to return.
"People realised he was not responsible for the defeats. He was the one getting them to finals," Levinsky added.
Under Lionel Scaloni, Messi became the undisputed leader of a new generation, guiding Argentina to two Copa America titles and the 2022 World Cup.
His evolution into a more outspoken captain drew comparisons with Diego Maradona, but Levinsky said the usual debate between Argentina's two biggest icons missed the point.
"It is Messi and Maradona," he added. "They were both geniuses in different eras."
For Levinsky, Argentina's affection for Messi was not as immediate as it was for Maradona. It developed around a player whose upbringing and career unfolded largely abroad but who grew closer to supporters over time.
"Messi was like suddenly finding out you have an 18-year-old son," Levinsky said. "You have to start loving him without having known he existed. It was a love under construction."

"He went through so many moments that they're really very different eras. At first he suffered enormously with the national team. He truly endured it," Argentine journalist and author Sergio Levinsky, who wrote "Messi and Everything Else", told Reuters.
Messi moved to Barcelona as a teenager and, while Spain tried to persuade him to represent them, his own country barely knew he existed.

Finding the boy from Rosario proved difficult.

"His name isn't Leonardo, it's Lionel," Souto was told, according to the documentary "Messi: The Forgotten Tape".

"People realised he was not responsible for the defeats. He was the one getting them to finals," Levinsky added.

His evolution into a more outspoken captain drew comparisons with Diego Maradona, but Levinsky said the usual debate between Argentina's two biggest icons missed the point.

items.title: Nicaragua anuncia su retiro de parlamento centroamericano en medio de críticas de la OEA
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Nicaragua anunció su retiro inmediato del Parlamento Centroamericano (Parlacen), tras recibir críticas de la Organización de Estados Americanos (OEA) que exige al Gobierno de Daniel Ortega y su esposa Rosario Murillo restaurar las libertades públicas en el país.
items.body:
Nicaragua anunció su retiro inmediato del Parlamento Centroamericano (Parlacen), tras recibir críticas de la Organización de Estados Americanos (OEA) que exige al Gobierno de Daniel Ortega y su esposa Rosario Murillo restaurar las libertades públicas en el país.
La decisión fue notificada mediante un comunicado de la Cancillería nicaragüense emitido la tarde del sábado y distribuido a los medios de prensa.
El Gobierno indicó que decidió denunciar el Tratado constitutivo del Parlacen, o su retiro formal del pacto, suscrito en Guatemala el 2 de octubre de 1987, "en ejercicio pleno de su soberanía" y señaló que la denuncia tendrá "efecto inmediato".
El pasado viernes, los cancilleres de la OEA aprobaron por consenso general una resolución que pide al Gobierno de Managua restaurar las libertades en el país, liberar a decenas "presos políticos" y celebrar elecciones con participación de todas las fuerzas políticas. No hubo ningún voto en contra de los países centroamericanos.
En julio pasado, Ortega anunció que en Nicaragua no habrán elecciones en las que intervengan "golpistas", en alusión a la oposición.
El Gobierno de Nicaragua no respondió de inmediato a un pedido de comentarios.
Nicaragua vive una crisis política desde abril de 2018, cuando una serie de protestas sociales fueron reprimidas por la policía, con un saldo de más de 350 muertos, 2.000 heridos y miles de detenidos y exiliados.

items.title: Woman at center of Cornell rape allegations targeted with threats, lawyer says
items.author: Nolan Mccaskill
items.creator: Nolan Mccaskill
items.summary: Thomas Giuffra told CNN that people have threatened to silence or harm her if she does not withdraw her civil lawsuit alleging that several members of a fraternity drugged and raped her in 2024.
items.body:
The woman who has alleged that she was drugged and raped by Cornell University students has been the target of threats, her lawyer said on Sunday.
Thomas Giuffra, who represents the woman identified as "Jane Doe," told CNN that people have threatened to silence or harm her if she does not withdraw her [USN:L1N45O0OO TEXT:"civil lawsuit"] alleging that several members of a Cornell fraternity drugged and raped her in 2024.
"She's received multiple threats," Giuffra said on CNN's "State of the Union."
Giuffra said he had also been threatened.
"I'm not afraid of these people," he said. "But the threats, the abuse to protect what's going on, the status quo — these guys are disgusting. They should stay in their mother's basement and stay out of the world."
Cornell University President Michael Kotlikoff said in a video message on Saturday that the university [USN:L1N45P06O TEXT:"will examine"] the role of fraternities and sororities on campus following the [USN:L6N45O14X TEXT:"outcry"] over the school's handling of the rape allegations.
"At their best, these organizations can provide students with friendship, belonging, mentorship and a powerful sense of community," he said. "But being part of a group can never diminish individual responsibility."
Since the lawsuit was filed last month, prosecutors in Tompkins County, New York, have been criticized for their initial handling of the allegations in 2024. New York Governor Kathy Hochul last week named state Attorney General Letitia James as [USN:L1N45O00M TEXT:"special prosecutor"] to look into the case.
US President Donald Trump, a critic of James for years, lambasted the decision to appoint her. "And I feel badly for whoever she's looking at because they won't get a fair shake," Trump told reporters on Friday.
Asked about Trump's comment, Giuffra said the case shouldn't be politicized. "It has nothing to do with politics," Giuffra said.

items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Pittsburgh Steelers defensive lineman Derrick Harmon is expected to miss multiple weeks with a foot injury, NFL Network reported on Sunday.
items.body:
Pittsburgh Steelers defensive lineman Derrick Harmon is expected to miss multiple weeks with a foot injury, NFL Network reported on Sunday.
Per the report, injured reserve is a consideration for the Steelers (2-2) after Harmon was carted off the field on Thursday during the first half of a 27-24 loss to the Cleveland Browns. He was sporting a walking boot after the game.
Harmon, 23, recorded 12 tackles, 1 1/2 sacks and a forced fumble in four games (one start) this season.
He has totaled 39 tackles and 4 1/2 sacks in 16 career games (nine starts) since being selected by the Steelers with the 21st overall pick of the 2025 NFL Draft.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Commanders QB Marcus Mariota injured vs. Colts
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Washington Commanders lost quarterback Marcus Mariota to a right knee injury in the first quarter of their 30-13 loss to the Indianapolis Colts in London on Sunday.
items.body:
The Washington Commanders lost quarterback Marcus Mariota to a right knee injury in the first quarter of their 30-13 loss to the Indianapolis Colts in London on Sunday.
Mariota was injured after being sacked by Laiatu Latu on a third-and-goal play. Mariota appeared to get his leg twisted under him while going down. He left the field under his own power and later went to the locker room. He was ruled out at halftime.
Mariota completed 3-of-4 passes for 46 yards and ran once for 35 yards before departing the game. He guided Washington (1-3) to field goals on its first two possessions as he filled in for starting quarterback Jayden Daniels (left elbow).
Rookie Athan Kaliakmanis, a seventh-round pick out of Rutgers, replaced Mariota and became the first quarterback from the 2026 draft class to take a snap in a regular-season game.
Kaliakmanis finished 15-of-33 passing for 186 yards with a touchdown and an interception.
In other injury news, Commanders return specialist Jaylin Lane was carted off the field after suffering what appeared to be a serious injury to his lower left leg.
On Sunday, he returned three kickoffs for 80 yards and two punts for a combined 17 yards.
The Commanders began the game without top receiver Terry McLaurin, who suffered a hamstring injury in practice on Friday.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Nicaragua announces withdrawal from Central American Parliament
items.author: Gabriela Selser
items.creator: Gabriela Selser
items.summary: Nicaragua is withdrawing from the Central American Parliament, furthering its isolation on the international stage as the country is accused of rampant human rights abuses.
items.body:
Nicaragua is withdrawing from the Central American Parliament, furthering its isolation on the international stage as the country is accused of rampant human rights abuses.
In a statement on Saturday, the foreign ministry said that it had decided to denounce the 1987 treaty establishing the six-country parliament "in the full exercise of its sovereignty". It said the move would take immediate effect.
The government of Nicaragua did not immediately respond to a request for further comment.
The action followed a resolution on Friday from the Organization of American States that called on Nicaraguan authorities to [USN:S0N41D00X TEXT:"free political prisoners"] and restore civil liberties. Nicaragua left the OAS in 2023, saying the diplomatic organization had become a tool for US interventionism.
In 2025, Nicaragua also said it would [USN:L2N3PI1NK TEXT:"withdraw"] from the United Nations Human Rights Council following a UN report that urged the international community to address human rights violations by Nicaragua.
Nicaragua has been in the grip of a political crisis since April 2018, when social protests that were suppressed by police resulted in more than 350 deaths, 2,000 injuries and thousands of detentions and people fleeing the country.
Last July, the government run by Daniel Ortega and his wife, Rosario Murillo, announced the country would [USN:L8N43M12V TEXT:"no longer hold elections"]. Ortega has continuously held power since 2007 following an earlier presidential term in the 1980s.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
[アデン ４日 ロイター] - サウジアラビアが支援するイエメン暫定政権の指導者であるアリーミ大統領評議会議長は４日、親イラン武装組織フーシ派に対する大規模な軍事作戦の開始を発表した。フーシ派が支配する地域を奪還して全土の掌握を目指す。

アリーミ氏は、演説で「本日、共和国の残りの領土を奪還し、国家とその機関の権限を国土全体に及ぼすための軍事作戦の開始を宣言する」と述べた。
items.body:
[アデン ４日 ロイター] - サウジアラビアが支援するイエメン暫定政権の指導者であるアリーミ大統領評議会議長は４日、親イラン武装組織フーシ派に対する大規模な軍事作戦の開始を発表した。フーシ派が支配する地域を奪還して全土の掌握を目指す。

アリーミ氏は、演説で「本日、共和国の残りの領土を奪還し、国家とその機関の権限を国土全体に及ぼすための軍事作戦の開始を宣言する」と述べた。 軍や治安部隊、全ての軍事組織に対し、承認済みの計画に基づき割り当てられた任務の遂行を始めるよう命じたと述べた。 

２０２２年に合意した停戦はおおむね守られてきたが、今年に入り、イラン戦争が波及し、フーシ派がサウジの船舶や石油インフラへのミサイル・無人機攻撃を始めた。

アリーミ氏は演説で、フーシ派が紛争を沈静化させる取り組みに応じず、さらに緊張を激化させたと非難し、事態打開の可能性が尽きたため、攻撃の開始を決めたと説明した。

サウジは１５年、フーシ派によって首都サヌアを追われた、国際的に承認された政府を支援するため、アラブ連合軍を率いてイエメンの内戦に介入した。

アリーミ氏はサウジの支援に謝意を示した上で、地域の同盟国や国際的パートナーに対し、イエメン暫定政権とその軍への支援を呼びかけた。

一方、フーシ派は４日、サウジの首都リヤドや東部クライスにある国有石油会社サウジアラムコの施設を弾道ミサイルと無人機（ドローン）で攻撃し、大規模な火災を引き起こしたと発表した。過去１２時間の間にサウジ主導の有志連合軍がイエメン国内で５０回に及ぶ空爆やミサイル攻撃を行ったことへの報復だとした。 フーシ派は前日も、リヤドのアラムコの施設を弾道ミサイルと無人機で攻撃したと発表していた。

中東地域や西側の当局者はロイターに、サウジがフーシ派に対する軍事作戦を計画していると述べていた。

items.title: Verstappen gana en Malasia el caótico Gran Premio de Baréin, retrasado por la lluvia
items.author: Rohith Nair
items.creator: Rohith Nair
items.summary: Max Verstappen, de Red Bull, se impuso el domingo en Malasia en un caótico Gran Premio de Baréin, marcado por la lluvia, logrando así su primera victoria de la temporada, después de que el inicio de la carrera se retrasara más de 90 minutos debido a las complicadas condiciones del Circuito Internacional de Sepang.
items.body:
Max Verstappen, de Red Bull, se impuso el domingo en Malasia en un caótico Gran Premio de Baréin, marcado por la lluvia, logrando así su primera victoria de la temporada, después de que el inicio de la carrera se retrasara más de 90 minutos debido a las complicadas condiciones del Circuito Internacional de Sepang.
Verstappen había sido el último piloto en ganar en Sepang en 2017, antes de que la prueba fuera retirada del calendario, y el neerlandés, que también había conseguido la pole, dio a Red Bull su primera victoria con su propio motor, a pesar de un contratiempo inicial en el que perdió el liderato antes de la primera curva.
"Es una victoria realmente buena tras el año que hemos tenido y los progresos que hemos logrado. Así que estoy increíblemente orgulloso de todos. Es estupendo ganar aquí", dijo Verstappen.
El líder del campeonato, Kimi Antonelli, quedó segundo con Mercedes y ahora cuenta con una ventaja de 84 puntos sobre su rival más cercano y compañero de equipo, George Russell, que iba tercero cuando se retiró por un presunto problema en la unidad de potencia a cinco vueltas del final.
Lewis Hamilton, de Ferrari, terminó tercero a pesar de una apuesta arriesgada con los neumáticos que había hecho caer al británico hasta la posición 18 al inicio de la carrera.
"Obviamente, tomamos una decisión equivocada al principio, lo cual fue muy difícil, y veía cómo todos se alejaban", dijo Hamilton. "Pensé que la carrera se nos había acabado, pero seguí concentrado. Los chicos hicieron un gran trabajo en las paradas en boxes".
Antonelli mantuvo la segunda posición frente a Hamilton en las últimas vueltas.
"Hoy hemos sacado el máximo partido posible… Por nuestra parte, nos queda mucho trabajo por hacer", dijo Antonelli. "Hemos tenido más dificultades de lo habitual, pero aun así estamos muy contentos de haber conseguido el segundo puesto".
Las últimas cuatro vueltas fueron una lucha directa por los puestos del podio tras un largo periodo del auto de seguridad, y fue entonces cuando Hamilton, que llevaba varias vueltas persiguiendo a Isack Hadjar, de Red Bull, dio el paso decisivo.
Charles Leclerc, quien también había estado más cerca de la parte trasera de la parrilla al inicio de la carrera en medio del caos de una pista mojada, salvó el cuarto puesto para Ferrari al adelantar a Hadjar a dos vueltas del final.
Hadjar terminó quinto, por delante de Oscar Piastri, de McLaren. Liam Lawson fue séptimo, mientras que Fernando Alonso quedó octavo con Aston Martin, su mejor resultado de la temporada.
PRIMERA CARRERA EN PISTA MOJADA DE 2026 La temporada aún no había tenido una carrera con el piso mojado en la que se pudieran poner a prueba los monoplazas de 2026 y la lluvia, que se había mantenido alejada en los entrenamientos y la clasificación, llegó con fuertes aguaceros que barrieron el circuito, retrasando la salida.
Tras una suspensión del procedimiento de salida, en la segunda largada los pilotos se dividieron entre neumáticos intermedios y lisos, pero fueron los primeros los que se impusieron al inicio de la carrera.
Cuando se apagaron las luces, Antonelli aceleró por el centro desde la tercera posición de la parrilla para arrebatarle el liderato a Verstappen, mientras que Russell se coló por el exterior para pasar de la séptima a la segunda posición.
Pero la remontada de Verstappen comenzó en la sexta vuelta, cuando atacó a Russell, adelantando al británico metiéndose por el interior de la curva cuatro para poner su mirada en Antonelli.
El italiano tuvo que defender su posición hasta la vuelta 10, cuando Valtteri Bottas hizo un trompo con su Cadillac y se salió a la grava, lo que provocó la salida del auto de seguridad; mientras tanto, Verstappen entró en boxes y los dos Mercedes se alinearon en doble fila para cambiar a neumáticos lisos.
Cuando el auto de seguridad se retiró, Verstappen se pegó a la rueda trasera de Antonelli antes de adelantar al italiano en la curva tres, mientras que Russell también superó a su compañero de equipo en la siguiente curva, invirtiendo así el orden.
Verstappen parecía cómodo marcando el ritmo en cabeza, ya que firmó las vueltas más rápidas y amplió su ventaja sobre Russell a más de cuatro segundos, mientras un frustrado Antonelli informaba al equipo de que tenía el ritmo necesario para perseguir al neerlandés .
Un impaciente Antonelli adelantó a Russell en la vuelta 21 para situarse segundo, mientras que, por detrás de ellos, Hamilton había ido recortando distancia discretamente con sus neumáticos blandos, ya desgastados, hasta situarse quinto, detrás de Hadjar.
Pero Antonelli se pasó del punto de frenada en la curva 15 y se salió brevemente de la pista, golpeando el bolardo del pit lane, lo que le costó un tiempo valioso mientras Verstappen ampliaba su ventaja a ocho segundos.
Cuando salió el segundo auto de seguridad hacia el final de la carrera debido al Williams de Alex Albon, que se había quedado atascado en la grava, Russell detuvo de repente su automóvil en la recta principal y sacudió la cabeza al salir del monoplaza, con un presunto problema en la unidad de potencia.
items.raw_description: Max Verstappen, de Red Bull, se impuso el domingo en Malasia en un caótico Gran Premio de Baréin, marcado por la lluvia, logrando así su primera victoria de la temporada, después de que el inicio de la carrera se retrasara más de 90 minutos debido a las complicadas condiciones del Circuito Internacional de Sepang.

items.title: Russia says it hit Kyiv bridge, two vessels in Black Sea
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Russia hit on Sunday the Northern bridge over the Dnipro river in Kyiv, targeting a route used to transport troops and military cargo, the Russian Defence Ministry said.
items.body:
Russia hit on Sunday the Northern bridge over the Dnipro river in Kyiv, targeting a route used to transport troops and military cargo, the Russian Defence Ministry said.
The ministry also said it hit two dry cargo vessels carrying military equipment to the port of Odesa in the northwestern Black Sea.
In an earlier statement, the ministry said that Russian forces had struck a dry cargo vessel east of Odesa overnight, as well as a Nova Poshta logistics centre in Chornomorsk and a data centre in Odesa.
On Sunday, [USN:L1N45Q01Z TEXT:"Russia promised to intensify strikes on Ukraine"] after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy told Reuters that Kyiv would step up attacks on Russian oil refineries.
The ministry said air defence forces had intercepted and destroyed 559 Ukrainian drones between 2000 Moscow time (1700 GMT) on Saturday and 0800 Moscow time (0500 GMT) on Sunday over multiple Russian regions and above the Azov and Black seas.
Reuters could not independently verify the claims made by either side of the conflict.

items.title: Trump nomeia Jay Clayton, chefe de inteligência, como czar da IA para liderar força-tarefa
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou no domingo que nomeou o diretor de Inteligência Nacional, Jay Clayton, como “czar” da inteligência artificial, encarregando-o de coordenar os esforços do governo federal para manter a liderança dos EUA nessa tecnologia.
items.body:
O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou no domingo que nomeou o diretor de Inteligência Nacional, Jay Clayton, como “czar” da inteligência artificial, encarregando-o de coordenar os esforços do governo federal para manter a liderança dos EUA nessa tecnologia.
Trump, que tem pressionado para que a inteligência artificial seja renomeada como “superinteligência”, disse que Clayton chefiará a recém-criada Força de Superinteligência (SIF), supervisionando o envolvimento do governo com consumidores, grupos religiosos, empresas de IA e outras partes interessadas.
Em uma postagem em sua plataforma Truth Social, Trump escreveu que a SIF terá como objetivo “garantir que os Estados Unidos continuem liderando o mundo em superinteligência” e “proteger os interesses e melhorar a vida de todos os americanos”.
O anúncio confirmou uma reportagem do Wall Street Journal na qual Clayton, nomeado chefe de inteligência em agosto, afirmou que Trump o havia escolhido para liderar os esforços do governo para manter os EUA na vanguarda da IA. “O risco de não sermos os primeiros é alto”, disse Clayton ao jornal.
Clayton afirmou que a força-tarefa terá 120 dias para elaborar um relatório avaliando os riscos e oportunidades apresentados pela IA e recomendando qual papel o governo federal deveria desempenhar.
A segurança da IA tornou-se uma questão importante nas últimas semanas, com alguns pesquisadores alertando que as pessoas que desenvolvem a tecnologia acreditam que ela poderia matar seres humanos dentro de uma década. Vários parlamentares democratas e republicanos reagiram com preocupação e pediram mais medidas.
Trump parece ter adotado uma postura mais branda em relação à regulamentação da IA, argumentando que uma supervisão excessiva poderia enfraquecer a competitividade frente à China. Ele afirmou na terça-feira que não deseja trabalhar com o presidente chinês, Xi Jinping, na regulamentação da tecnologia de IA.
O painel de Clayton analisará os riscos relacionados à IA e os atuais mecanismos governamentais de notificação de violações, ataques cibernéticos e outros incidentes, além de recomendar formas de fortalecer as capacidades de resposta federal dentro das competências existentes, informou o Journal, citando o regulamento da força-tarefa.
Esta é a segunda vez que Trump nomeia um assessor para supervisionar as decisões relacionadas à IA. O investidor de capital de risco David Sacks ocupou o cargo de “czar da IA” no início do segundo mandato de Trump.

items.title: Horse racing-Dazzling Daryz thrills to win back to back Arc de Triomphes
items.author: Virginia Furness
items.creator: Virginia Furness
items.summary: Daryz clinched a historic victory over Bay City Roller to win his second consecutive Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe at Longchamp on Sunday, the first colt to do so in nearly half a century.
items.body:
Daryz clinched a historic victory over Bay City Roller to win his second consecutive Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe at Longchamp on Sunday, the first colt to do so in nearly half a century.
Always prominent Bay City Roller defied his 28/1 odds to run a valiant race having hit the front two furlongs out under jockey Oisin Murphy, after running wide in the early stages. Still, Daryz proved to have too much class.
Rounding the bend, last year's winner, who went off 7/4 favourite for trainer Francis-Henri Graffard, showed an incredible turn of foot and surged up the outside to pull clear of the pack and deny the battling Bay City Roller in the final stages of the race. Fancied three-year-old filly Diamond Necklace defied a wide draw to finish a credible third.
"What an amazing ride and what an amazing racehorse he is, he wears his heart on his sleeve and he has all the talent and all the ability to go with it," said Bay City Roller's trainer George Scott.
"We came up second best to an outstanding racehorse on good ground, and congratulations to connections. Francis is a gentleman."
Europe's richest flat race the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe attracts the world's best middle-distance horses who compete for glory, and a share of the five-million-euro ($5.63 million) prize pot, at the storied Paris track. It is the pinnacle of many trainer's careers.
Daryz's double is the first since the great mare Enable who won the race in 2017 and 2018 and stakes his claim as one of the world's greatest middle-distance racehorses.
He is the first colt in 48 years to win back-to-back renewals of the race and his success cements the Aga Khan Studs as the Arc's most successful winning owners.
Daryz is without a doubt a Longchamp specialist having won at the course three times already this year. The French superstar has amassed nearly three million pounds ($3.97 million) in prize money and his only subpar performance of the season came at Ascot when he was third to Ombudsman in the Group 1 Prince of Wales's Stakes.
The race rounds off a fantastic weekend for British trainer George Scott who scored a career best with a double on the first day of the meeting. Caballo De Mar denied eight-time winner Scandinavia in a thrilling finish in the long-distance Prix du Cadran after Wimbledon Hawkeye clinched the Prix Dollar.

items.title: Brasileños acuden a las urnas en unas elecciones marcadas por la polarización y mucho en juego
items.author: Brendan O'Boyle, Luciana Magalhaes, Rodrigo Viga
items.creator: Brendan O'Boyle, Luciana Magalhaes, Rodrigo Viga
items.summary: Los brasileños formaban largas filas para votar el domingo en la primera vuelta de unas elecciones muy reñidas, tras una campaña marcada por escándalos, incertidumbre económica y acusaciones de injerencia de Estados Unidos.
items.body:
Los brasileños formaban largas filas para votar el domingo en la primera vuelta de unas elecciones muy reñidas, tras una campaña marcada por escándalos, incertidumbre económica y acusaciones de injerencia de Estados Unidos.
La elección entre 13 candidatos, han sido dominada por dos claros favoritos, el presidente izquierdista Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, de 80 años, que busca un cuarto mandato no consecutivo, y el senador Flávio Bolsonaro, hijo de 45 años del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, quien espera devolver al poder el movimiento derechista de su padre.
Una victoria de Bolsonaro prolongaría la ola de triunfos en América Latina de candidatos de derecha alineados con Donald Trump, mientras que la reelección de Lula podría suponer un dolor de cabeza para Washington, que ha tenido enfrentamientos con su gobierno en materia de comercio y seguridad.
A pesar de la creciente preocupación por la salud fiscal de Brasil y su lento crecimiento económico, la campaña ofreció poco debate político sustancial, ya que los candidatos principales se ausentaron de los principales debates televisados.
Si ningún candidato obtiene más del 50% de los sufragios válidos, los dos más votados se enfrentarán en la segunda vuelta el 25 de octubre. Las encuestas muestran a Lula y Bolsonaro prácticamente empatados en caso de un balotaje.
FAVORITOS EMITEN SU VOTO Las repercusiones de la condena de Jair Bolsonaro el año pasado han marcado gran parte de la campaña.
Trump, quien calificó dicho caso de "caza de brujas", impuso un arancel del 50% a Brasil en 2025, vinculando explícitamente los gravámenes al juicio contra Bolsonaro tras las gestiones de la familia Bolsonaro para presionar al Supremo Tribunal Federal de Brasil a retirar los cargos.
Flávio ha prometido solicitar una amnistía para su padre, quien cumple una condena de más de 27 años por planear un golpe de Estado tras su ajustada derrota electoral en 2022.
Los aliados de Lula han advertido que la administración Trump podría negarse a reconocer los resultados si él gana, señalando un intento frustrado de enviar funcionarios estadounidenses a Brasil.
"Lo que está en juego es el futuro de Brasil", dijo Lula tras votar en Sao Bernardo do Campo, en el estado de Sao Paulo. Aunque los sondeos realizados hasta el mismo sábado indicaban que Lula probablemente lideraría la primera vuelta pero no evitaría una segunda, Bolsonaro declaró a los periodistas que confiaba en ganar la presidencia en la primera ronda.
"Nuestras encuestas internas muestran que superamos la primera vuelta hace tiempo", dijo Bolsonaro tras votar en Río de Janeiro, donde estuvo acompañado por su madre, Rogéria Bolsonaro, quien aspira a un escaño en la Cámara de Diputados de Brasil.
Trump no ha respaldado formalmente a ningún candidato, aunque recibió al senador Flávio Bolsonaro en la Casa Blanca y lo elogió públicamente.
El senador, que se ha comprometido a estrechar lazos con Estados Unidos e Israel, celebró la designación por parte del gobierno de Trump de las principales bandas criminales de Brasil como grupos terroristas, decisión que Lula rechazó.
Otro factor importante es el acceso de Estados Unidos a las vastas reservas de minerales críticos de Brasil, clave para el impulso de Washington por reducir la dependencia de China.
DIFICULTADES ECONÓMICAS A pesar de la disminución de la desigualdad y el desempleo, Lula ha tenido dificultades para ganarse a los votantes que se enfrentan al aumento del costo de la vida, a las elevadas deudas de los hogares y la creciente actividad de las bandas criminales.
Sin embargo, las políticas sociales del presidente han seguido resultando atractivas para algunos votantes que apoyan su agenda progresista.
La arquitecta Mariana Kiel, de 53 años y residente en Sao Paulo, dijo que planeaba votar por Lula. "Hemos tenido un gobierno que reconoció que, para que un país crezca, todos deben progresar juntos", afirmó Kiel, quien paseaba a su perro vistiendo una camiseta de Lula.
Flávio Bolsonaro ha intentado sacar provecho de la preocupación por el costo de la vida, mientras que Lula ha tomado medidas para prohibir las apuestas en línea, a las que se culpa de alimentar la deuda y, a medida que la contienda se estrechaba, amplió las ayudas sociales y anunció la condonación de deudas para las familias.
El aumento del gasto y una deuda pública superior al 82% del PIB han avivado preocupaciones fiscales que el próximo presidente de Brasil podría tener que abordar. El Gobierno redujo sus previsiones de crecimiento económico para este año y el próximo a apenas un 2,0% y un 2,3%, respectivamente.
"Necesitamos sacar a Lula porque está destruyendo el país", dijo a Reuters Fernando Tempel, un consultor de gestión de 49 años. Aunque planeaba votar por otro candidato, Tempel dijo que cambió de opinión para apoyar a Flávio Bolsonaro, citando decisiones recientes de la corte suprema sobre las elecciones.
El escándalo que rodea al ahora desaparecido Banco Master ha eclipsado el debate sobre políticas públicas, salpicado a gran parte de la clase política brasileña y reavivando la indignación pública por la corrupción.
Daniel Vorcaro, el antiguo director del banco, fue arrestado a principios de este año por un presunto fraude multimillonario. La investigación ha indagado sobre los vínculos de Vorcaro con figuras que van desde el magistrado de la corte suprema Alexandre de Moraes hasta el propio Flávio Bolsonaro, quien está siendo investigado por blanqueo de dinero relacionado con el caso.
El senador ha negado haber cometido irregularidades, aunque confirmó haber recibido millones de dólares de Vorcaro para financiar una película sobre su padre.
Las conexiones del banquero con Moraes, considerado por muchos como un aliado de Lula, sumieron al STF en una crisis un mes antes de la votación, creando nuevos problemas para el presidente. Moraes ha sostenido que el caso tiene motivaciones políticas y electorales derivadas de la condena que él mismo dictó contra el padre de Bolsonaro.

items.title: Djokovic rallies past Zverev in thriller to reach China Open semi-finals
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Novak Djokovic produced a trademark comeback to defeat top seed Alexander Zverev 4-6 6-4 6-4 and reach the China Open semi-finals on Sunday, extending his unbeaten record in the tournament.
items.body:
Novak Djokovic produced a trademark comeback to defeat top seed Alexander Zverev 4-6 6-4 6-4 and reach the China Open semi-finals on Sunday, extending his unbeaten record in the tournament.
Playing the ATP 500 event in Beijing for the first time since 2015, the six-time champion was pushed to the limit by reigning French Open and US Open champion Zverev, who delivered 19 aces in the match.
Meeting for the first time in nearly 16 months, Djokovic struggled to contain the German's power in the early stages as the 29-year-old Zverev claimed the opening set, but the Serb gradually worked his way into the match and refused to let his opponent pull away.
"I had a terrible start. Two double faults at the beginning. It was quite cold and honestly, I didn’t feel warmed up, but my fault," Djokovic said.
"I gave him an early break and then it was hard to come back in the first set."
The contest was briefly interrupted by a moment of controversy when Zverev argued that LED advertising signage had gone dark during a rally and requested a video review after losing the point.
Replays showed a section of the signage had switched off, though not as Zverev was missing the forehand. The chair umpire ordered the point to be replayed, prompting a frustrated exchange from Djokovic.
TURNING POINT The turning point came late in the second set when Djokovic broke at 5-4 to level the match, shifting the momentum in his favour after a tightly contested battle.
With little separating the pair in the third, the Serbian struck again at 5-4 on the Zverev serve, securing the decisive break to seal victory in two hours and 35 minutes.
"I was trying to be aggressive and come to the net, and change up the pace, not giving the same pattern," Djokovic said.
"I am just glad that I held my nerves, played good shots at important moments, 5-4 in the second and third."
The pair had not met since Roland Garros in 2025, where Djokovic won in four sets, and Sunday's encounter again highlighted the Serb's ability to deliver under pressure despite a season disrupted by [USN:L4N45O15G TEXT:"physical issues"].
With the victory, Djokovic moved a step closer to a seventh China Open title and an elusive first trophy of the year, while denying [USN:L6N45P02N TEXT:"Zverev"] another opportunity to strengthen his bid for the world number one ranking.
Djokovic will face Daniil Medvedev in the semi-finals after the Russian defeated Francisco Cerundolo 7-6(4) 6-3 earlier on Sunday.

items.title: Most Gulf shares end higher on firmer oil, US rate bets
items.author: Ateeq Shariff
items.creator: Ateeq Shariff
items.summary: Most Gulf stock markets ended higher on Sunday, with the Saudi index buoyed by firm oil prices, softer US rate expectations and renewed investor appetite after recent heavy selling.
items.body:
Most Gulf stock markets ended higher on Sunday, with the Saudi index buoyed by firm oil prices, softer US rate expectations and renewed investor appetite after recent heavy selling.
Saudi Arabia’s benchmark index (.TASI) , which had suffered five consecutive weekly losses, rebounded 1.1%, led by a 1.7% gain in Al Rajhi Bank (1120.SE) .
Elsewhere, oil major Saudi Aramco rose 0.6%, tracking steady oil prices, with Brent crude settling at $102.25 a barrel on Friday, down just 6 cents.
Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak [USN:S8N44E05C TEXT:"said"] that at Sunday's meeting, the Joint Ministerial Monitoring Committee noted that global oil markets were still volatile and tight because supply was falling short.
US job growth [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"slowed sharply"], with nonfarm payrolls rising by just 29,000 in September, well below the 90,000 expected, while August’s increase was revised down to 133,000 from 162,000.
The weaker data eased expectations of another Federal Reserve rate hike this month, with markets now pricing an 80% chance of rates remaining unchanged, up from 74% before the report.
Gulf markets tend to track shifts in US monetary policy expectations as most regional currencies are pegged to the dollar.
In Qatar, the index (.QSI) eased 0.1%.
Outside the Gulf, Egypt's blue-chip index (.EGX30) advanced 1.6%.
Saudi Arabia (.TASI) gained 1.1% to 10,506 Qatar (.QSI) eased 0.1% to 9,185 Egypt (.EGX30) advanced 1.6% to 53,911 Bahrain (.BAX) was up 0.1% to 1,907 Oman (.MSX30) increased 1% to 7,674 Kuwait (.BKP) eased 0.3% to 9,085

items.title: Evans ends years of heartache to take first world title
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Elfyn Evans ended years of heartache, and a quarter-of-a-century wait for Britain, by finally winning the World Rally Championship (WRC) title with Toyota after a dramatic season finale in Sardinia on Sunday.
items.body:
Elfyn Evans ended years of heartache, and a quarter-of-a-century wait for Britain, by finally winning the World Rally Championship (WRC) title with Toyota after a dramatic season finale in Sardinia on Sunday.
The Welshman had been championship runner-up five times in the last six years but emerged triumphant after a final Powerstage duel with teammate Oliver Solberg ended with the charging Swede crashing out two corners from the finish while on course to take the crown.
Solberg, 25, ran wide and careered down a bank before getting the car back on the road. He still won the rally but lost the crucial bonus points on offer for the top five in the final stage.
Evans, with co-driver Scott Martin at his side, became the first British world rally champion since Englishman Richard Burns in 2001 and only the third since Scottish driver Colin McRae became the nation's first in 1995.
END OF AN ERA FOR RALLYING Sweden's Solberg, son of Norway's 2003 champion Petter, ended the season as runner-up. The final standings left Evans on 243 points, Solberg on 238 and Sami Pajari on 237 in what was also the end of an era for the sport with new regulations in force next year.
"It hasn't sunk in. I was sure it was over. I didn't drive the best stage but threw everything at it but it wasn't clean. I feel for Oliver. He had an incredible weekend," said Evans, who completed his final run first and had to watch and wait to see whether he had done enough to take the title.
"I don't really know what my reaction is, it's surreal with how it happened. It's a relief. It wouldn't be my proudest way of winning it, but it's job done," added the 37-year-old, who finished fifth in the gravel rally.
Evans had started the rally -- the final round after Saudi Arabia's finale was cancelled due to conflict in the region -- 17 points clear of Finland's Pajari, also in a Toyota, and 21 clear of Solberg.
The Swede took control of the rally on Saturday, knowing he had nothing to lose and all to gain, and started the final day 33.6 seconds clear of the field and the momentum swinging his way.
That feeling was reinforced when Evans lost time changing a wheel on Sunday's penultimate stage, leaving the championship outcome hanging on the short final stage and the title going to which of the pair finished ahead of the other.
Toyota had already won the manufacturers' championship.

items.title: Pétrole-L'Opep+ maintient ses quotas de production pour novembre
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: L'Opep+ a décidé de maintenir ses objectifs de production de pétrole pour novembre, a déclaré l'organisation dans un communiqué publié à l'issue de sa réunion de ce dimanche.
items.body:
L'Opep+ a décidé de maintenir ses objectifs de production de pétrole pour novembre, a déclaré l'organisation dans un communiqué publié à l'issue de sa réunion de ce dimanche.
Peu avant cette déclaration, un délégué de l'organisation et trois sources avaient indiqué que l'Opep+ était parvenu à un accord de principe pour un statu quo sur la production.
L'Opep+ rassemble les pays membres de l'Opep et d'autres pays producteurs de pétrole menés par la Russie.
Les pays producteurs du Golfe, membres de l'Opep+, ont maintenu leur production bien en deçà des objectifs fixés en raison des perturbations affectant les exportations à la suite du déclenchement en février dernier de frappes israélo-américaines sur l'Iran.
Ces derniers mois, ces exportations ont fluctué entre 60% et 80% des niveaux normaux.
La guerre a également retardé l'examen des capacités de production de l'Opep+, un élément crucial pour déterminer les quotas de production des membres pour 2027, car elle engendre une incertitude quant au potentiel de production future, selon des sources industrielles.
L'Opep+ a relevé ses objectifs de production pour une grande partie de l'année 2026 après des années de réductions, mais la plupart de ces augmentations sont restées lettre morte en raison du conflit en cours au Moyen-Orient.
Les sept membres principaux de l'Opep+ ont produit 25 millions de barils par jour en août, soit une hausse de 630.000 barils par jour par rapport à juillet, mais ce seuil est toujours en dessous d'environ 5 millions de barils par jour des niveaux d'avant-guerre, selon les données de l'organisation.
L'Opep+ maintient des réductions de production d'environ deux millions de barils par jour, qui concernent la plupart de ses membres. Un examen des capacités est nécessaire pour déterminer la manière de répartir les hausses, et une éventuelle modification de la production est peu probable avant 2027, selon des sources.

items.title: Le président yéménite annonce une offensive d'envergure contre les Houthis
items.author: Timour Azhari, Eman Abouhassira, Mohammed Ghobari
items.creator: Timour Azhari, Eman Abouhassira, Mohammed Ghobari
items.summary: Le président yéménite, dont le gouvernement est soutenu par l'Arabie saoudite, a annoncé dimanche le lancement d'une vaste opération militaire contre les rebelles houthis pro-iraniens, visant à reprendre le contrôle des territoires qu'ils occupent.
items.body:
Le président yéménite, dont le gouvernement est soutenu par l'Arabie saoudite, a annoncé dimanche le lancement d'une vaste opération militaire contre les rebelles houthis pro-iraniens, visant à reprendre le contrôle des territoires qu'ils occupent.
"Aujourd'hui, j'annonce le lancement d'opérations militaires visant à reprendre le reste du territoire de la République et à étendre l'autorité de l'Etat et de ses institutions à l'ensemble du territoire national", a déclaré Rachad al Alimi dans une allocution télévisée.
Des responsables régionaux et occidentaux ont dit il y a quelques jours à Reuters que l'Arabie saoudite et ses alliés yéménites prévoyaient cette offensive contre les Houthis, les Saoudiens s'occupant des combats aériens et les forces yéménites combattant au sol.
De leur côté, les Houthis ont annoncé ce dimanche avoir lancé des drones et des missiles balistiques sur des sites d'Aramco, la compagnie pétrolière nationale de l'Arabie saoudite, dans les régions de Ryad et de Khurais.
Ils ont précisé que ces attaques, qui ont provoqué de gigantesques incendies, étaient des représailles contre, selon eux, 50 frappes menées contre le Yemen au cours des 12 dernières heures par la coalition dirigée par l'Arabie saoudite.
Ryad n'a pas confirmé à ce stade les attaques revendiquées par les Houthis.
Selon Rachad al Alimi, la décision de lancer cette contre-offensive a été prise après l'épuisement de toutes les possibilités de désescalade, la président yéménite accusant les Houthis d'avoir répondu aux efforts visant à apaiser le conflit par une mobilisation accrue et une escalade.
"Notre position aujourd'hui est d'assumer la responsabilité nationale de faire face aux Houthis, après que toutes les possibilités de désescalade ont été épuisées", a-t-il déclaré.
Rachad al Alimi a dit avoir ordonné aux forces armées, aux forces de sécurité et à toutes les formations militaires de commencer à exécuter les missions qui leur ont été confiées, conformément aux plans approuvés.
L'IMPORTANCE DE TAÏZ, TROISIÈME VILLE DU PAYS La reprise du conflit au Yemen a provoqué le déplacement de dizaines de milliers de personnes et pourrait redessiner le paysage politique, avec des répercussions sur les voies maritimes de la mer Rouge et le [USN:L8N4530M9 TEXT:"détroit de Bab el-Mandeb"], autre axe vital pour le transport maritime mondial d'hydrocarbures.
Les Houthis, qui se sont emparés en septembre 2014 de la capitale yéménite Sanaa, résultat d'un complexe jeu d'alliances sur fond de guerre civile, résistent depuis plus de dix ans à une coalition mise sur pied par l'Arabie saoudite, en s'appuyant sur un arsenal de drones et missiles balistiques constitué avec l'aide de Téhéran.
Une trêve conclue sous l'égide des Nations unies entre les parties belligérantes en 2022 a globalement tenu jusqu'à cette année, quand les Houthis ont commencé à lancer des attaques contre le transport maritime et les infrastructures pétrolières saoudiennes, en réaction à l'attaque lancée le 28 février par les Etats-Unis et Israël contre l'Iran.
Les Houthis, qui contrôlent les zones les plus peuplées du Yémen et une grande partie du nord du pays dont la capitale Sanaa, ont lancé plusieurs attaques contre l'Arabie saoudite - alliée des Etats-Unis - et en mer Rouge depuis leur annonce en juillet dernier d'un blocus maritime des ports saoudiens.
Malgré les préparatifs d'une contre-offensive, les Houthis ont jusqu'à présent conservé l'initiative sur le terrain, et ce plusieurs semaines après s'être emparés du détroit de Bab el-Mandeb lors d’une offensive éclair le long de la côte.
Ce détroit, la sortie sud de la mer Rouge, est une voie maritime clé entre la Méditerranée et l'Asie et elle a pris encore plus d'importance, depuis le début de la guerre déclenchée le 28 février contre l'Iran, en tant qu'alternative au détroit d'Ormuz, puisque ce dernier a de fait été fermé par Téhéran.
Au cours des dernières 48 heures, les Houthis ont réalisé des avancées face aux forces gouvernementales et locales sur des collines stratégiques près de Taïz, dans le sud-ouest du Yémen, ont dit des sources militaires.
Les Houthis ont ainsi progressé sur la dernière route reliant la ville à Aden, où est basé le gouvernement yéménite soutenu par l'Arabie saoudite.
La prise de contrôle par les Houthis de la route Taïz-Aden entraînerait un siège de fait de Taïz, troisième plus grande ville du Yémen, où vivent des centaines de milliers de civils et où sont également stationnés des milliers de soldats des forces gouvernementales.
La ville revêt une importance qui ne tient pas uniquement à sa position stratégique: le président yéménite Rachad al Alimi est originaire de cette région et un siège de Taïz exacerberait une situation humanitaire déjà désastreuse dans le pays.
La [USN:L6N45O0MZ TEXT:"famine"] au Yémen s'aggrave, avec un nombre record d'habitants incapables de subvenir à leurs besoins alimentaires, alors que le conflit avec l'Arabie Saoudite s'intensifie, a déclaré vendredi le Programme alimentaire mondial (PAM).

items.title: Espagne-Deux morts dans des inondations en Catalogne
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Deux personnes ont péri et une autre est portée disparue à la suite de fortes pluies et d'inondations dans la région de Catalogne, en Espagne, ont rapporté dimanche les autorités.
items.body:
Deux personnes ont péri et une autre est portée disparue à la suite de fortes pluies et d'inondations dans la région de Catalogne, en Espagne, ont rapporté dimanche les autorités.
Le président de la Généralité de Catalogne, Salvador Illa, a confirmé dimanche, dans un message publié sur les réseaux sociaux, le décès d'un homme à la suite de l'effondrement d'un mur à Tordera, ville située au nord de Barcelone.
Une autre personne a trouvé la mort à Montornès del Vallès, ont précisé les pompiers, tandis que les services d'urgence étaient à la recherche d'une personne portée disparue à Pineda de Mar, ville située à 52 km au nord de Barcelone.
Les autorités catalanes ont émis une alerte rouge et ont exhorté la population à rester chez elle de 20h00 (18h00 GMT) samedi jusqu'à 14h00 (12h00 GMT) dimanche, car un "mini-ouragan" risque de frapper le nord-est de la région, avec de nouvelles prévisions de fortes pluies.
Des habitations ont été inondées et des voitures se sont retrouvées submergées à Bellvitge et à Cornellà, près de Barcelone, après les pluies torrentielles de samedi.
Sarai Sarroca, directrice du service météorologique régional Meteocat, a déclaré samedi que le cœur d'un système météorologique exceptionnel se trouvait au-dessus de la Méditerranée et qu'un "mini-ouragan" pourrait se déplacer vers la Catalogne.
Des vols ont été annulés ou retardés à l'aéroport de Barcelone, a rapporté samedi le journal La Vanguardia.
Tous les trains régionaux ont été perturbés par ces pluies torrentielles. Les magasins ont fermé plus tôt, des matches de football ont été annulés et une représentation de l'"Aïda" de Verdi à l'opéra du Liceu de Barcelone a été annulée.

items.title: Lula prevê vitória e pede participação dos 70+ na eleição ao votar em São Bernardo
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), candidato à reeleição, votou nesta manhã de domingo em uma escola em São Bernardo do Campo (SP), quando previu sua vitória e fez um apelo para que os eleitores com mais de 70 anos compareçam às urnas.
items.body:
O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), candidato à reeleição, votou nesta manhã de domingo em uma escola em São Bernardo do Campo (SP), quando previu sua vitória e fez um apelo para que os eleitores com mais de 70 anos compareçam às urnas.
Lula estava acompanhado na seção eleitoral de seu vice, Geraldo Alckmin, também candidato à reeleição, de Fernando Haddad (PT), candidato ao governo do Estado de São Paulo, e seu vice, Márcio França (PSB), além das candidatas ao Senado Marina Silva (Rede) e Simone Tebet (PSB).
"Tenho feito um apelo para que as pessoas com mais de 70 anos, que pela lei não precisam votar, compareçam para votar, porque as pessoas não têm que votar apenas pensando nelas, as pessoas têm que pensar no Brasil, as pessoas têm que pensar nos seus filhos, as pessoas têm que pensar nos seus netos, as pessoas têm que pensar no futuro daqueles que elas vão deixar", disse Lula a jornalistas, após a votação.
O presidente também reafirmou que o que está em jogo nas eleições deste domingo é a escolha entre o fortalecimento do regime democrático e a barbárie. Ele disse, ainda, que as pesquisas eleitorais feitas até o momento "não valem nada" diante da "pesquisa" efetiva que será feita neste domingo nas urnas.
Pesquisas [USN:L6N45O13P TEXT:"divulgadas"] no sábado mostraram que a eleição não deve ser definida neste domingo. Levantamentos do Datafolha e da Quaest colocaram Lula e Flávio em empate técnico no primeiro turno nos votos válidos.

items.title: Sustained reforms, self-reliance critical for Viksit Bharat, says Das
items.author: Krity Ambey
items.summary: Shaktikanta Das said India must build stronger domestic capabilities while remaining integrated with global markets and concluding more free trade agreements ...
items.body: Principal Secretary to Prime Minister Shaktikanta Das on Sunday called for continued reforms and greater self-reliance as India seeks to sustain its growth momentum and achieve the Viksit Bharat goal of becoming a developed economy by 2047. “India stands at a pivotal moment in its development journey,” Das said at the Kautilya Economic Conclave organised by the Ministry of Finance. Sustaining the momentum of reforms would be critical to realising the Viksit Bharat vision, he said. Aatmanirbharta, or self-reliance, will be an important part of this next phase, Das said, while stressing that it should not mean turning inward. “Aatmanirbharta does not imply isolation. Rather, it stands for building stronger domestic capabilities while remaining integrated with global markets and concluding more free trade agreements,” he said. India has concluded around eight trade deals in the last five years, most of them with developed economies. It has implemented two free trade agreements (FTAs) in the current financial year and is on track to enforce another with New Zealand later this month. The focus now is on expanding India’s role in global supply chains, strengthening strategic manufacturing and developing critical technologies domestically, Das said. He outlined four other areas that would be key to accelerating growth — harnessing artificial intelligence (AI), deepening the financial sector and bond markets, advancing environmental sustainability, and investing in human capital. On AI, Das called for investment in indigenous foundation models, high-performance computing infrastructure and semiconductor development ecosystems to build sovereign capabilities. As India’s economic weight expands, its financial architecture will also need to deepen, he said. The next phase of growth would require stronger channels for long-term finance and greater availability of patient capital. Das also flagged risks from the global economic environment. With monetary policies expected to remain restrictive and debt levels likely to rise in advanced economies, bond yields could harden further, he said. The current global economy is characterised by wars, fragmentation, unilateralism, technological blockade, energy price volatility and rising inflation, he said. “The interplay of these forces is creating uncertainty across the world, and would perhaps stifle global growth.” Despite these challenges, the Indian economy remains resilient, he said. The Indian economy was also better positioned to absorb global oil shocks, he added. This resilience, built on the back of structural reforms undertaken over the past decade, provides a strong foundation for the next phase of reforms, Das said. “The leap to Viksit Bharat 2047 is very much in the realm of realisation,” he said.

items.title: Trump picks John Coale as special presidential envoy for hostage affairs
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US President Donald Trump said on Sunday that lawyer and current Belarus envoy John Coale, who has been credited with the release of hundreds of prisoners, would be his special presidential envoy for hostage affairs.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump said on Sunday that lawyer and current Belarus envoy John Coale, who has been credited with the release of hundreds of prisoners, would be his special presidential envoy for hostage affairs.
Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko [USN:L1N45G0P5 TEXT:"pardoned 15 prisoners"] last month after talks with Coale, who has been talking to Minsk for more than a year.
"John has already secured the return of over 65 Americans and Allied Citizens from Belarus over the last year, and negotiated the release of more than 800 political prisoners from multiple countries in Eastern Europe," Trump wrote in a post on Truth Social.
Coale will replace Adam Boehler, who Trump said had brought back 196 hostages. Boehler, who in August helped to [USN:L1N4480MS TEXT:"secure the release"] of a former American marine from Russia, will continue to assist in other matters as a senior adviser, Trump added.

items.title: Golden Knights embrace life on road, take aim at Canucks
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: After splitting two games at home to begin the season, the Vegas Golden Knights head to the Pacific Northwest for a two-game road trip beginning Sunday night against the Vancouver Canucks.
items.body:
After splitting two games at home to begin the season, the Vegas Golden Knights head to the Pacific Northwest for a two-game road trip beginning Sunday night against the Vancouver Canucks.
Forward Brett Howden said he thinks getting away from home will be good for the defending Western Conference champions, who went a solid 19-14-8 on the road last season.
"It's been a while since we've been on the road ... so I think it will be good for our group to get together," Howden said. "It's a quick trip but excited to get on the road with the guys. Two important games for us."
Vegas, which had Saturday off in Vancouver, also plays at Seattle on Tuesday before returning home to host the Toronto Maple Leafs on Thursday.
The Golden Knights opened the season with a 5-2 victory over Chicago on Tuesday but then were defeated by the Anaheim Ducks, 4-3, on Friday.
Anaheim built a 4-0 lead in that contest with three of the goals coming in the first 7:03 of the second period.
Vegas, which has never rallied from a four-goal deficit to win a game in franchise history, made things interesting with three goals in the third period. The Knights had several good scoring chances to tie it after pulling goalie Carter Hart for an extra attacker but couldn't get the tying goal past Lukas Dostal.
"We're one play away in the end in the blue paint from tying it up," Vegas coach Ryan Craig said. "You get down by four it's hard to come back. Proud of our guys for the effort and the urgency."
Said captain Mark Stone: "You're never going to see this team quit. I think that's why we've had some playoff success and some regular-season success as a team. We don't quit. We continue to push. But when you get down 4-0, you are not going to come back very often."
Vegas swept all three meetings with Vancouver last season, outscoring the Canucks, 11-5, in the process. The Golden Knights have won the last seven in the series dating back to a 4-3 loss on April 8, 2024.
Vancouver, which finished with an NHL-worst 58 points last season, split two games with the Edmonton Oilers to begin the season before posting a 4-1 victory over the Calgary Flames on Saturday.
Liam Ohgren, playing in his 100th NHL game, scored a goal and also assisted on defenseman Elias Pettersson's game-winning tally during a four-goal third period. Leevi Merilainen finished with 23 saves to pick up the win in his first start in net for the Canucks.
After the Canucks won just nine times in 41 home contests (9-27-5) last season, Ohgren said developing a tough home ice advantage was a big goal for the team heading into this season.
"It feels great. We talked about it has to be hard to come here and play against us, and I felt like tonight was exactly like that," Ohgren said. "I'm happy to get that first win at home, and now we've just got to keep it going."
--Field Level Media
